Log of decimation rate used on HE/EHT CSIs Note that during CSI-Expansion states (i.e. states in which CSI is generated from data and not from an LTF) this register is never used, even if packet is HE/EHT. 0 is No decimation 1 is decimation by 2 2 is decimation by 4 3 is decimation by 8

Decimation offset used for HE/EHT CSI's. Note that during CSI-Expansion states (i.e. states in which CSI is generated from data and not from an LTF) this register is never used, even if packet is HE/EHT. Should be between 0 and (2 power LogDecimRateHe)-1

Log of decimation rate used on HE/EHT CSIs Note that during CSI-Expansion states (i.e. states in which CSI is generated from data and not from an LTF) this register is never used, even if packet is HE/EHT. 0 is No decimation 1 is decimation by 2 2 is decimation by 4 3 is decimation by 8

Log of decimation rate used on Legacy/HT/VHT CSIs Note that during CSI-Expansion states (i.e. states in which CSI is generated from data and not from an LTF) this register is used, even if packet is HE/EHT. In that case the value of the register may be changed by FW during any RXF-CSI-FSM state which is not a channel-estimation state or DataProcess state. 0 is No decimation 1 is decimation by 2 2 is decimation by 4 3 is decimation by 8

This is the BF-Report-RAM base address for non-legacy-CSI Note that this is used also for CSI-Expansion modes, even if they are based on legacy packets. Also note that the BfReportRamAddBaseLegacy, used for the legacy CSI, is set at 0, and not exported as a register.

This sets the number of left-shifts performed on the HVal before it is quantized into CSIs {8,8} bits. Allows to tune the CSIs dynamic range. The higher the number in the reg, the smaller the dynamic range is and the smaller the quantization noise it.
Initiates a CSI-Expansion of Antenna-switching type. Note that actual switching of the antenna needs to be configured through

Marks to the CSI-FSM that the AFE/DFE transient immediately following the ant/freq switch, as seen in the TdAcq input, is over. Note that the HW shall automatically add the necessary delays to this in order to make sure next CSI is generated from a non-corrupt symbol.
